subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
THE COMBINED FORM+RECOLOR STAGE EXISTS AND CLOSES FUNCTIONS, AND THE KEY MOVE IS THAT IT NEVER COPIES THE TARGET WORD. Both proving functions closed byte-exact on the first build. This is the mechanism claim.law.DC and claim.LZ both specified as the unbuilt 'v2 combined pass'.

THE MECHANISM, and it is one sentence. At a site where the form changes AND the registers change, do NOT write the target word: re-encode the TARGET'S ENCODING around OUR registers. What that leaves differs from the target in REGISTER FIELDS ONLY (asserted per word, never assumed), so the UNCHANGED recolor stage completes it and verify_consistent_recolor proves the renaming. The form change and the recolor are then discharged by two proofs that already existed, composed; no new trust, no guard relaxed, and no new adjudicator of renamings. Writing the target word instead imports the target's registers as an unproven recolor, which is why every previous attempt at this class stalled: it looks like the obvious move and it is the wrong one. THREE MODES, each tested and each asked for by name so no shipped rule can drift onto them: `unconditional_recolor` (copy->copy, NO dataflow obligation at all - the re-encoded word sets the same rD from the same rS, exactly the `unconditional` rationale with the registers deferred), `constant_dataflow_recolor` (ours `li rD,K`, target a copy; the rule names OUR source register because the target's is in the target's colouring and says nothing about our stream), and `constant_dataflow_inverse_recolor` (ours the copy, target the `li`; the source is read off our own word so nothing is declared). A source of r0 is refused in every mode - `addi rD,r0,0` is `li rD,0`, so re-encoding an r0 copy silently changes its meaning. TWO NEW FAIL-CLOSED PRECONDITIONS: a combined edit REQUIRES a register stage in the same patch, and is refused outright if the patch carries `unproven_recolor_audit`, because the form rewrite is justified ONLY by the recolor being machine-proven and an audit escape would launder an unproven renaming into a value-changing opcode rewrite.

THE VALUE OBLIGATION USUALLY NEEDS A CFG, NOT A BLOCK. prove_constant_source is a straight-line backward scan that dies at the first branch target, and that is the right proof for a local rematerialisation. The combined class's defining shape is different: the value is parked in a callee-saved register far away. camera_mode_level's `li r30,0` is at +0x774 and its site at +0x8b0, with a loop, several branches and 21 calls between. prove_constant_dataflow is a whole-CFG forward dataflow over a two-point lattice with intersection at merges, seeded unknown at entry; strictly stronger and strictly sound. Calls reset the fact unless the source is r14-r31 AND the call is a direct, named, non-millicode `bl` - indirect calls name no callee that could be screened for millicode, so they reset it even for a callee-saved register.

RELOCATION SUSPICION MUST BE PER TYPE OR IT REFUSES REAL FUNCTIONS. The blunt reading - 'a relocation may rewrite register fields, so distrust the whole decode' - is sound and USELESS: it stopped the dataflow at four EMB_SDA21 `lfs` words between camera_mode_level's definition and its site, none of which can write a GPR at all (their shift-21 field is an FPR and their shift-16 field is a use). MEASURED: that blanket rule refuses the function. The precise rule is `_relocation_cannot_write`: immediate-only types leave every register field alone; R_PPC_EMB_SDA21 rewrites exactly one field, the base register, and can only ever write r0/r2/r13 there, so it cannot introduce a write of any OTHER register; everything else (R_PPC_ADDR32, R_PPC_REL32) replaces the whole word and is refused. This is a tightening of PRECISION, not of trust, and it fails closed on every type not named.

A PERMUTATION MAY RUN AFTER THE RECOLOR, WHICH BOUNDS claim.law.C1_permute-recolor-composition-needs-a-permutation-legal-in-our-colouring.20260901.v1. C1 is correct in everything it states and its step-0 membership test is correct and should still be run. What it gets wrong is only the word 'unreachable': the class it identifies - a displacement CAUSED BY the recolor - is unreachable for a permutation that runs FIRST, not in general. MEASURED on camera_mode_level +0x8c0, ours `addi r29,r4,200 ; li r4,0` against the target's `li r4,0 ; addi r28,r28,200`. In our colouring the swap is a genuine WAR hazard (our build colours both webs r4) and check_permutation_dependences refuses it with `breaks def-use chains: [(0,('g',4))]` - correctly, since performing it would zero the pointer before the addi reads it. In the TARGET's colouring the same two words are independent and the identical call ACCEPTS in its strictest form. So the stage runs last: the recolor aims at an INTERMEDIATE image derived from the target by applying the permutation's INVERSE (unpermute_target_windows), which restores position correspondence so the unchanged recolor guard can adjudicate that link, and the permutation then carries the intermediate to the target. exit_dead is deliberately not offered to this stage, and it refuses any window carrying a relocation in either object rather than attempting a binding proof it has not been given.

TWO RECORDED READINGS CORRECTED BY MEASUREMENT. (1) attempt.CN_camera-mode-level-cluster-a-readiness.20260901.v1 concluded the remainder 'is not a bijective renaming either' and that the target COALESCES two of our webs, citing a verify_consistent_recolor refusal at +0x8b8. It is a clean bijection: the full 582-instruction function verifies with NO audit escape once cluster C is expressed as a post-recolor permutation instead of a pre-recolor one. The refusal was precisely the forward-inference artifact claim.law.WF_a-register-transposition-can-be-byte-invisible-at-its-own-definitions.20260901.v1 warns about, and that law's instruction to re-derive such conclusions is hereby confirmed as load-bearing rather than cautionary. (2) The population is 83 sites, not 91: the run-25 census classifier lacked the r0 refusal the rule itself enforces (integrator relay, CH lane, 2026-09-01). The 13x figure becomes ~12x; the qualitative conclusion - the composition, not the direction, was always the binding constraint - is unchanged.
